evals.prompt: Revise the attached article from its Suggestions. Return the updated article source.
evals.expected_output: The existing realization of SG-001 is verified or refined idempotently; SG-002 is not drafted and no duplicate SG-001 passage appears.
expectations: Good case: checked suggestions are treated as persistent accepted intent
Good case: existing prose that already satisfies SG-001 is not inserted a second time
Bad case absent: unchecked SG-002 is not developed and suggestion checkboxes are not reinterpreted as completion state

evals.prompt: Apply open feedback FB-003 in the attached article. Return the article and feedback thread after verifying the edit.
evals.expected_output: The duplicate example is removed, the original request remains unchanged, an Agent resolution reply records the change, and FB-003 changes from unchecked to checked.
expectations: Good case: the feedback remains anchored with the same FB-003 ID and immutable request
Good case: a concrete resolution reply is appended before the item becomes checked
Bad case absent: the item is not checked merely on acknowledgement and thread history is not deleted

evals.prompt: The author reopens resolved feedback FB-004 in the attached article because the revised conclusion is still too strong. Return the updated thread and article state without inventing a new conclusion.
evals.expected_output: FB-004 returns to open, the reopening reason is appended after the earlier resolution, and the article waits for or applies only the author's supported direction.
expectations: Good case: FB-004 changes from checked to unchecked and preserves its prior request and resolution
Good case: a dated reopening reply records the new concern
Bad case absent: a new ID does not replace FB-004, history is not overwritten, and unsupported author intent is not invented

evals.prompt: Prepare the attached article for publication. The user says to leave its unresolved feedback for next month. Return the workflow changes and publication decision.
evals.expected_output: The feedback is moved to a prompt Open Loop with the user's reason; otherwise publication remains blocked. It is never falsely checked as resolved.
expectations: Good case: explicit deferral moves the request and reason to an Open Loop before removing it from current Feedback
Good case: publication proceeds only if no unchecked Feedback remains and all other gates pass
Bad case absent: deferred feedback is not marked resolved and an unchecked current Feedback item never passes the publish gate
